top_repos.name: live-stock-market
top_repos.description: ESP32 Live Stock Tracker – Solo-built device that fetches real-time stock prices over Wi-Fi, parses JSON, and displays tickers on an I2C OLED. Designed hardware, firmware, API handling, and UI. Learned microcontroller networking, JSON parsing, I2C displays, memory-efficient code, and building stable always-on embedded systems.

top_repos.name: mailbox
top_repos.description: Wireless Smart Mailbox – Solo-built ESP32 package counter with a wireless home display. Designed hardware, sensors, enclosure concept, and firmware with debounce and reliable communication. Learned embedded systems, IoT prototyping, sensor logic, and real-world debugging.
